title: Metronome subdivision patterns
description: A versioned list of rhythmic subdivision patterns for the metronome. Each pattern divides the beat into `division` equal slots and spans `beats` beats before it loops. CROSS-FIELD RULE (not expressible in JSON Schema, enforced by parsePatterns in model.ts): `slots` must contain exactly `division * beats` entries. Ids must also be unique; a later duplicate is ignored. String lengths are counted in Unicode code points, here and in the parser. Invalid entries are dropped individually, and a document with any other `version` is ignored entirely.

patterns.description: Patterns in display order. The first five are shown as quick toggles; all of them appear in the presets list.

id.description: Unique slug. This is what gets stored in a user's settings, so do not rename a published pattern.

label.description: Short name shown on the quick-toggle button (and on the Presets button when this pattern is selected).

title.description: Full name shown in the presets list. Defaults to `label`.

description.description: One line describing the rhythm, shown under the title in the presets list.

tags.description: Tags for filtering the presets list. The parser trims and lowercases each tag, drops invalid or repeated ones without rejecting the pattern, and keeps at most 8.

division.description: Equal slots per beat. Every slot lasts 60 / bpm / division seconds.

beats.description: How many beats the pattern spans before it loops. The pattern always restarts from slot 0 at the start of a bar, so a pattern longer than what is left of the bar is cut short.

slots.description: Exactly `division * beats` entries, in time order. At least one must sound (`beat` or `sub`): an all-`rest` pattern is rejected.

items.description: beat: sounds at the emphasis level (soft / normal / accent) of the beat it falls inside. sub: quiet tick. rest: silent, time still advances. A beat the user has switched off silences every slot inside it.
